[Core message] A young man leaves his motorcycle outside a convenience store for “just a moment.” A thief notices the unattended vehicle and takes it. The victim discovers the loss seconds later. End with practical advice: lock the steering, add a secondary lock, park in a supervised area, and report a theft promptly. The theft must be shown through its consequences and the characters’ actions. Do not show a close-up demonstration of defeating a lock, using a theft tool, or starting a vehicle without its key. [Location and continuity lock] One continuous evening scene on a realistic street in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. A small convenience store opens onto a sidewalk. The thief wears a charcoal jacket, dark helmet, and face mask. The victim wears a light blue shirt and carries a small shopping bag. Keep their faces, clothing, and vehicles consistent. [Visual and editorial style] Realistic reenactment combined with restrained legal-news graphics. Use clear wide shots to establish where the store, victim, thief, and motorcycle are located; medium shots for actions; close-ups for the victim’s reaction and prevention measures. A brief security-camera-style angle may appear, labeled “TÌNH HUỐNG TÁI HIỆN.” Editing should be brisk but legible. Maintain cause and effect: the victim parks, walks inside, the thief approaches, the motorcycle disappears, and the victim returns. No sensational chase, violence, comedy, or exaggerated cinematic effects. Use clean Vietnamese typography. Graphics should be short and readable. The voice-over is a natural Vietnamese newsreader voice with a Southern Vietnamese accent, measured and serious, approximately 65–75 Vietnamese words across 30 seconds. Voice-over remains clearly audible above subdued street ambience and a restrained investigative music bed. No character dialogue is needed. [30-second storyboard] Shot 1 — 0–3 seconds: Immediate hook Open on the empty parking spot outside the convenience store. The victim rushes into frame, stops, and looks around in alarm. A quick cut shows the dark blue scooter in that exact spot moments earlier. On-screen headline: “CẢNH GIÁC TRỘM XE MÁY” Voice-over: “Chỉ một phút rời mắt, chiếc xe có thể biến mất.” Shot 2 — 3–7 seconds: Establish what happened Transition clearly to “ít phút trước.” A wide street-level shot shows the victim arriving on the dark blue scooter and parking outside the store. He glances toward the brightly lit entrance and walks in with his phone in hand. The camera holds long enough to show the scooter left unattended near the curb. Small caption: “TÌNH HUỐNG TÁI HIỆN” Voice-over: “Người đàn ông dựng xe trước cửa hàng rồi vội bước vào trong.” Shot 3 — 7–12 seconds: Suspicious approach From a medium distance, show the masked thief moving along the sidewalk. He notices the scooter, looks toward the store, and approaches. Cut briefly to a high, fixed-angle security-camera-style view with a subtle timestamp. Keep the thief’s hands and the vehicle’s ignition area out of close-up. Voice-over: “Thấy xe không có người trông coi, đối tượng nhanh chóng tiếp cận.” Shot 4 — 12–17 seconds: Theft without instructional detail The thief’s body briefly blocks the camera’s view of the scooter. Cut to the store interior: the victim is paying at the counter, unaware. Cut back to a wide street shot as the scooter moves away and exits the frame. Do not depict the technical method used to take it. Street traffic continues naturally. On-screen text: “SỰ VIỆC XẢY RA CHỈ TRONG CHỐC LÁT” Voice-over: “Khi chủ xe còn ở bên trong, chiếc xe đã bị lấy đi.” Shot 5 — 17–22 seconds: Discovery and response The victim comes back out carrying a small bag. He stops at the empty parking spot, looks both ways, then asks store staff for help. Show him checking the store camera with staff and using his phone to report the incident. His reaction should be believable and restrained. Voice-over: “Phát hiện mất xe, anh kiểm tra camera và trình báo cơ quan chức năng.” Shot 6 — 22–27 seconds: Prevention montage Three clear, realistic close shots, each about one second: a rider turns the steering lock; a secondary lock is secured; a motorcycle is parked in an attended parking area and the rider receives a parking ticket. Each action must be visually unambiguous. On-screen checklist: “KHÓA CỔ” “THÊM KHÓA PHỤ” “GỬI XE NƠI CÓ NGƯỜI TRÔNG” Voice-over: “Hãy khóa cổ, dùng thêm khóa phụ và ưu tiên nơi gửi xe có người trông.” Shot 7 — 27–30 seconds: Closing warning Return to a steady wide shot of the storefront and its now-empty parking spot. Fade to a simple dark background with high-contrast text. Hold the final card long enough to read. Final card: “ĐỪNG CHỦ QUAN DÙ CHỈ RỜI XE VÀI PHÚT” Voice-over: “Đừng chủ quan, dù chỉ rời xe vài phút.” Music resolves quietly. End cleanly at exactly 30 seconds. [Audio and text rules] All spoken language and on-screen text must be Vietnamese. The voice-over must match the action shown at that moment. Keep captions correctly accented and large enough for mobile viewing. Prioritize intelligible speech over music. Use natural store and street ambience; no sirens unless they appear naturally in the scene. [Negative constraints] No real news-channel branding. No claim that this fictional reenactment is actual CCTV footage. No detailed lock-bypass technique or theft-tool close-up. No instructional view of the ignition. No weapon, assault, police raid, arrest, motorcycle chase, dramatic crash, or invented crime statistics.
